news.headline: Tulane names a new starting quarterback
news.summary: Coach Will Hall said Tuesday that Kadin Semonza will start Saturday against South Alabama. Semonza came off the bench at halftime at Duke and led Tulane's only scoring drive.

news.headline: Tulane's coach says the mistakes can be fixed
news.summary: Will Hall took the blame for the offense after Saturday's 17-3 loss at Duke. Tulane was flagged for 15 penalties, and Hall changed quarterbacks at halftime.

news.headline: Duke beats Tulane 17-3 in the opener
news.summary: Tulane's offense never got going Saturday at Duke and the Green Wave managed only a field goal. Duke running back Nate Sheppard carried the ball 35 times for 227 yards and two touchdowns.

news.headline: Sumrall wants a cleaner game from the Gators
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that his defense was not sharp in the 66-21 win over Florida Atlantic. He also said the bad snaps from his center will get fixed before Campbell visits on Saturday.

news.headline: Florida receiver Eric Singleton may miss Saturday
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Singleton hurt his ankle in the win over Florida Atlantic and is highly questionable for the Campbell game. Sumrall said the team will not know for sure until later in the week.

news.headline: Two Florida players got hurt in the opener
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said receiver Eric Singleton Jr. hurt an ankle and running back Evan Pryor had a sore hip in Saturday's win. Sumrall did not know how bad either one is and will say more on Monday.

news.headline: Texas is No. 4 and hosts No. 1 Ohio State
news.summary: The new Associated Press poll came out Tuesday with Ohio State first and Texas fourth. The two teams play Saturday night in Austin.

news.headline: Texas running back Derrek Cooper is in a boot
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Cooper hurt his ankle in Saturday's win over Texas State and is wearing a walking boot. Cooper will miss the Ohio State game, and Sarkisian did not say how long he will be out.

news.headline: Texas lineman Cole Hutson cannot play right now
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Hutson is not eligible because he went to two NFL tryout camps last spring. Texas is appealing to the NCAA, and Hutson has started 23 games for the Longhorns.

news.headline: Saints name nine captains for the new season
news.summary: Cam Jordan, Erik McCoy, Justin Reid and Zach Wood are captains again, and five more players earned it for the first time. New starting quarterback Tyler Shough is one of them.

news.headline: Longtime Saints radio voice Mike Detillier dies
news.summary: Detillier talked about the Saints and LSU on WWL radio for more than 40 years. He died Sunday at age 65, and the Saints called him a true gentleman.

news.headline: Kamara and Cam Jordan may miss the opener
news.summary: Alvin Kamara hurt his knee in an August 18 practice and has not practiced since. Coach Kellen Moore has not ruled out Kamara or defensive end Cam Jordan for Sunday's game at Detroit.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Lake Erie for its fourth win in a row
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-16 and 25-14 on Saturday at home. Charlotte Potvin had 11 kills, Delaney Concannon had 15 digs, and IUP is now 5-3.

news.headline: IUP beats Daemen to finish a perfect weekend
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set Saturday at home and then won the next three, 25-20, 25-19 and 25-18. They went 4-0 in their own tournament, and Delaney Concannon had 19 kills and 20 digs.

news.headline: IUP beats Ashland in four sets at home
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks lost the first set 26-24 on Friday and then won the next three. Delaney Concannon had a season-best 20 kills, Jessica Neiman had 18, and IUP is now 4-3.

news.headline: Yankees beat Colorado 5-3 in Judge's first game back
news.summary: Aaron Judge played right field Tuesday night for the first time since May and went 0 for 3. Ryan McMahon hit the go-ahead double in the fifth inning, and Cam Schlittler pitched seven strong innings.

news.headline: Aaron Judge plays tonight for the first time since May
news.summary: The Yankees put Judge in the lineup Tuesday against Colorado, batting third and playing right field. He missed 84 games with a cracked rib and last played on May 31.

news.headline: Aaron Judge is back from the injured list
news.summary: The Yankees activated Judge on Monday night, more than three months after he cracked a rib. He is available for the Colorado series that starts Tuesday at Yankee Stadium.
